title: The envelope
thing: The envelope the list of names came in, kept by the art room. On its back, in pencil, is a line that reads oddly.
text: Oscar Day was longer than days at sea. Steel is tough, but the yellow one held.
fact: Read the way the Open Eye teaches, it says: "Card. Hand. List. Eye." Every card on the street was handed over in person, and the list went with them.
